example.content:
const systemLib = await eda.lib_LibrariesList.getSystemLibraryUuid();
const personalLib = await eda.lib_LibrariesList.getPersonalLibraryUuid();

const results = await eda.lib_Cbb.search('', systemLib, undefined, 1);
const source = results[0];

const newName = '嘉立创示例_复制_' + Date.now();
const copiedUuid = await eda.lib_Cbb.copy(source.uuid, systemLib, personalLib, [], newName);

_source.title: 复制复用模块
_source.example.text.0: 1. 获取系统库与个人库 UUID
_source.example.text.1: 2. 从系统库找一个复用模块作为复制来源
_source.example.text.2: 3. 复制到个人库，指定新名称避免同名冲突（分类传 [] = 不分类）
_source.example.text.3: 创建类保留现场（复制品留在个人库中供观察）
_source.params.libraryUuid: 库 UUID，可以使用 {@link LIB_LibrariesList} 内的接口获取
_source.params.newCbbName: 新复用模块名称，如若目标库内存在重名复用模块将导致复制失败
_source.returns: 目标库内新复用模块的 UUID

title: Copy Reuse block
params.libraryUuid: Library UUID, you can use {@link LIB_LibrariesList} APIs in
params.newCbbName: New reuse block name. If a reuse block with the same name exists in the target library, the copy will fail
returns: UUID of the new reuse block in the target library
